newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia eases rules for T-bill primary dealers.
newsitem.headline: Russia eases rules for T-bill primary dealers.

text.p: The Russian Central Bank will increase short cash position limits for primary dealers of Treasury Bills to two trillion roubles from 1.1 trillion roubles from March 24, a spokesman said on Friday.
The new terms will allow dealers to run up higher cash positions and increase liquidity of the T-bill market.
All T-bills with a remaining security of 14 days or over will now be eligible for repos. Previously the maturity had been 1-3 months.
Repos were started in October, allowing banks to run up a two-day overdraft with the Central Bank when buying government securities.
